Despite them all having the same denotation, none of these entities are related to each other. They do not have true names nor true numbers; they have just been labelled like that per prior police reports. Why they exist is unknown.<br><br>
list of the X-1200 Entities, aka the endless mode entities

|-|X-1200-A=
{{InfoBox:Entity
|entity_name=X-1200-A
|entity_image=<gallery>
X1200A1.png|1st Face
X1200A2.png|2nd Face
</gallery>
|nicknames=Speedy
|type=Rusher
|behavior=rushes to the main room Extremely fast, despawning past the door
|speed=Fast
|damage=???<br>??? DPS Snipe
|locker_snipe=Yes
|related_monsters=[[D-35i]]
|claustrophobia=No
|sound1=<center>Jumpscare</center><center>[[File:X-1200Jump.mp3]]</center>}}

<h2> Behavior </h2>
Once '''X-1200-A''' spawns, it will begin rushing to the main room, giving no indicator that it spawned, only way to detect it is by hearing the ambiance it makes, it being similar to [[False-60]]'s, once nearing the main room it will begin to fill the player's screen with static, a warning for them to hide immediately, it will despawn once it hits the door.

==Strategies & Tips==
* Once you hear him, get near a locker and enter when you see your screen being filled with static, that's it.

==Trivia==
* '''X-1200-A''' spawns 98 rooms behind the current room.

<h2> Behavior </h2>
Once '''X-1200-B''' spawns, it will place itself somewhere in the main room, it being black and white rings, seconds later it will activate and start making extremely loud noises to cover the sound from other entities for 15 seconds, despawning after said 15 seconds are over.

==Strategies & Tips==
* Stay near a locker at all times in case something spawned.

<h2> Behavior </h2>
Upon spawning, '''X-1200-C''' will place itself in a random direction, being able to be seen through walls similar to [[E-90]], then will start playing its ambiance and shake the screen of the player, moving and targeting anyone who isn't hiding, if everyone is hiding it will freeze in place, despawning after around 30 seconds.

==Strategies & Tips==
Keep a lookout for it, as it can be seen through walls, and if you do see it hide immediately.

Hiding in tables are also an option however only do this in case you are sure theres isnt an entity that can see you through them

When '''X-1200-D''' spawns, it will make a alarm sound and wait for around 30 seconds before rushing the the main room at fast speeds, it fill the players screen with static when nearby, a warning to hide immidietly, once it hits the door it will fallback, despawning past voidwall.

==Strategies & Tips==
* once you hear its spawn que get near a locker and hide once you see your screen being filled with static
